text: Dragan Kopunović is the creator of the project 'Your Own AI|Powered With Ease'.
The project 'Your Own AI|Powered With Ease' aims to help users acquire any skill and take control of their digital life.
The project has 43 backers who pledged CA$ 44,644 to help bring it to life.
The funding period for the project was from June 7, 2018, to July 11, 2018.
The project is based in Toronto, Canada.
The project is categorized under Software on Kickstarter.
withEase (wE) is a comprehensive Platform as a Service (PaaS) that provides a protected identity layer in any Internet collaboration.
wE uses Artificial Intelligence (AI) and a simple conversational interface to control, protect, and monetize personal and proprietary information.
Individuals can get paid for exposure to ads based on their own preferences and for their AI's responses to market research queries.
Enterprises can augment the IT lifecycle and implement new skills in a matter of minutes using the platform.
The current version of the wE platform is operational.
wE was built following a successful Kickstarter funding project with significant input from original backers.
All Kickstarter backers will receive free access to the current version of wE upon their pledge.
The current version of wE is the first completed phase of development.
The project aims to continue adding new features and functionality with support.
The funding goals include user-defined reminders, a service catalog, new skills in the public domain, and a biometric data vault prototype.

The wE system is described as a giant parallel queue processor with an AI algorithm for prioritizing and resource allocation.
The wE system has accumulated thousands of internal services over the years of development.
The services range from simple tasks like converting text to lower case to complex tasks like exporting content.
The wE system uses a nomenclature framework for app generation from policy text.
The framework includes properties of service input parameters and operational parameters.
The framework was finalized relatively recently, creating a legacy of thousands of available services.
The project seeks help to allocate resources to retrofit legacy services.
The project also aims to teach the wE AI about the intent of legacy services.

The Personal Biometric Data Vault prototype addresses biometric data privacy issues.
The patent titled 'Biometric verification with improved privacy and network performance in client-server networks' describes a method for biometric data security.
The method ensures that biometric templates never leave the intelligent device.
Biometric templates are encrypted using keys that self-destruct in unauthorized access attempts.
Input and existing biometric templates will be compared while encrypted.
Encrypted biometric templates will never be decrypted for any reason.
The only information ever leaving the device is unspecified in the text.
Biometric templates are encrypted using keys that self-destruct in unauthorized access attempts, rendering the templates unusable.
Encrypted biometric templates will never be decrypted for any reason.
The only information leaving the intelligent device will be the resulting authentication or verification score.
The project intends to build a prototype of a 'personal biometric data vault' with an implementation target of six months.

The objective is to provide backers with a tangible sense of the wE business model.
wE will provide a full suite of computing facilities to protect, control, and monetize users' own data.
Backers will pay for the usage of wE.
The value of users' data versus the cost of managing it is expected to be profitable.
All backing amounts will be converted to credEase, wE's $US pegged currency.
CredEase amounts will be doubled and allocated to backers' wEvatar's.
Backers can vote for any number of desired skills by allocating up to the total of the backing amount to any selected skill.
Backers can vote any number of times, but only the last vote will count.
Voting will close with the closing of the funding project.
The main reasons for the ongoing vote are to discover and rank as many skills as possible.

Backers wEvatars will be awarded with the Founder Privilege, which includes waiving of all banking charges upon redemption of credEase up to the total of the original backing amount.
The Founder Privilege also includes maintaining backer's wEvatar's financial reputation at a minimum of double the original backing amount.
The Founder Privilege maintains backer's wEvatar's network reputation at the highest level, benefiting both the backer's wEvatar and the entire backer's network.
The Founder Privilege is revocable in cases of repeated instances of user misrepresentation, misuse, or outright fraud.

Users can monetize their own Facebook data by downloading it and following specific steps.

Users can add selected Facebook topics to their wEvatar by replying to an email with specific commands.
